parameters.question: Compare A-to-I RNA editing site tables. Each editing site row must match the reference in genomic coordinates and nucleotide counts (A/C/G/T); editing_percentage must match within +/-0.1; confidence_score may differ due to scoring formula but must be a positive numeric value; variant_type labels may differ (e.g. 'A->G', 'A_to_I') as long as they indicate A-to-I editing; column order, row order and header labels may differ.
